exposure: feeding categories (exclusively breastfed, mixed formula fed and breastfed, and formula fed)
cohort: The study included 1201 term newborns (683 before and 518 after Baby-Friendly designation) whose data on birth weight, neonatal weights, feeding type, and demographics were collected.
finding: Baby-Friendly practices were associated with a decrease in mean weight loss in the first 0-2 days of life across all feeding types, and an increase in exclusive breastfeeding rates among all ethnic groups.
birth_weight: Term newborn (birth weight was controlled for in analysis)
